g.text: Each block is Conv1d → BatchNorm → ReLU. Padding is applied on the LEFT only, so position t is computed from positions ≤ t —

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #64748b

g.text: the layer cannot see its own future, and no pooling is used, so all 60 bars survive into the attention stage.
